data.description: Regardless of whether it is a natural or afflicted lycanthrope, a moonbound werewolf in animal or hybrid form gains DR 10/silver and magic when the moon is full. When the moon is full, the moonbound werewolf also gains +4 Strength and +4 Constitution in human form, and the bonuses he gains in hybrid and animal forms increase to +6. These changes increase its CR by 1.
data.name: Moonbound (Full Moon)
